inherited_findings.description: Body reduction claim cannot be independently verified from final time alone; this is evidence insufficiency, not demonstrated error.

evidence_anchors: The pilot reduced processing time by 7%.
The available report excerpt gives final processing time as 93 seconds but omits the baseline.
A 100-second baseline would yield a 7% reduction, but that baseline is not supplied.
reason: The question whether this report verifies 7% is answered correctly: it does not. The underlying reduction is unknown, not disproved. The hypothetical baseline is explicitly hypothetical and arithmetically correct; unchanged body and separate note are admissible.
limitations: The actual baseline is absent; the 7% factual verdict cannot be determined.
